description: Réseau de distribution électrique - Enedis- Auvergne - 2016 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by craig.fr. The data relate to the medium and low voltage electricity grid, for which Enedis (former ERDF) is a concessionaire. This network is either airborne or underground. Medium-scale data cover power lines (HTA ME, BT), substations and source substations, cut-offs. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity distribution network - Enedis- Auvergne - 2016" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include réseaux enterrés, Enedis, DT DICT, RTGE, ERDF, postes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
